verdict.rationale: Devin's docs mention a permission system that lets you 'control access at multiple levels' for MCP tools (devin-docs-13) and a general API for automating workflows (devin-docs-8), suggesting some access-control granularity, but there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped/least-privilege API keys or credentials specifically for an agent's own actions. missing for 10: explicit API-key scoping/least-privilege credential issuance workflow, documentation of credential expiry/role-based scopes, and independent confirmation of this permission system in practice.
